channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Damion Lee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Damion Lee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee
item.description:
“Players on our team from Bol Bol, Grayson Allen and Damion Lee, you’re seeing more and more players start their careers in the G League and grow, learn our system, learn how we want to play it, and one day contribute at the high-up stage of playing in NBA games,NBA playoff games and hopefully winning an NBA championship.”

Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee, May 23, 2024. Source: gophnx.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Otto Porter, Damion Lee
item.description:
“Otto Porter boxes out every single possession. Beli does a good job. Damion Lee. I just think we have a veteran group who understands if you plug all the leaks, you can keep that shell tight defensively and don’t worry about who is going to get the rebound. You can do it as a team, collectively.”

Steve Kerr on Otto Porter, Damion Lee, Nov 23, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Jordan Poole
item.description:
“Jordan Poole really came on down the stretch. Damion Lee had a helluva year. I thought (Mychal) Mulder and (Kent) Bazemore both really gave us a lot of help, helped us win games. So we’ll see how it all shakes out.”

Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Jordan Poole, Jun 4, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Mychal Mulder
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr:

“Mychal Mulder has really taken his opportunity and run with it these last couple of weeks after Damion went out,and I think that's one of the keys to our strong play of late.”

Steve Kerr on Damion Lee, Mychal Mulder, May 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Canon Curry on Kelenna Azubuike, Damion Lee
item.description:
Steph Curry on his son Canon mimicking Damion Lee's Eurostep:

“Kelenna Azubuike taught him that on the broadcast... I can't tell you how many times I've watched that video.”

Canon Curry on Kelenna Azubuike, Damion Lee, Jan 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.
